purpose: Admit, validate, idempotently archive, and acknowledge one delivered capability acknowledgement under Wire Protocol Version 1, so that manage-sender-installation can stop honoring superseded capability generations: answer with exactly one Delivery Receipt, retryable failure, or Delivery Block whose bytes match ingest-protocol's own evaluation for a delivering installation, archive the exact envelope before any receipt, keep pending, ended, and unknown installations retryable as accept-ingest-batch does, and make accepted sequence gaps visible.

inputs.name: delivered_bytes
inputs.description: The exact uncompressed bytes of one valid capability acknowledgement, which the ingress shell routes here after decoding its kind.

inputs.name: receipt_time
inputs.description: The timezone-aware Portal time of the delivery, supplied by the caller and recorded as the receipt time and Last Delivery.

inputs.name: operational_state
inputs.description: The Operational Store's installation lifecycle states, honored capability advertisements, archived message identities, sequence history, and storage reserve, read and written through operational-store@2.

inputs.name: free_space
inputs.description: Free bytes on the store's filesystem, which the store compares with its reserve when archiving.

outputs.name: delivery_response
outputs.description: accept-ingest-batch@1's DeliveryResponse: exactly one of a Delivery Receipt echoing the installation, sequence, and message SHA-256; a retryable failure with reason storage-reserve-exhausted or temporarily-unavailable; or a Delivery Block naming one closed ingest-protocol failure with the message's identity, together with its named failure and any accepted sequence gap.

outputs.name: archived_acknowledgement
outputs.description: For a newly accepted acknowledgement, the exact envelope, receipt, receipt time, and staged generation archived in one store transaction, with Last Delivery and any sequence gap; the latest acknowledged generation advances accordingly. Nothing for a retry, retryable failure, or Delivery Block.

outputs.name: delivery_block_record
outputs.description: A health-data-free Delivery Block record for every block: installation, sequence, message SHA-256, failure, and first and last seen times.

observable_effects.name: operational-store-write
observable_effects.description: Archives a newly accepted capability acknowledgement, or records a health-data-free Delivery Block, through operational-store@2; retries and retryable failures write nothing.

owns: the order in which a delivered capability acknowledgement is checked, and the mapping of each check to a receipt, retryable failure, or Delivery Block
applying ingest-protocol's identity, sequence, generation, and version rules for capability acknowledgements to durable store facts
does_not_own: wire schemas, exact bytes, and the closed failure vocabularies, which belong to ingest-protocol
the store's schema, transactions, retry identity, gap evidence, latest acknowledged generation, and storage reserve, which belong to operational-store
when a superseded generation stops being honored, and installation lifecycle transitions, which belong to manage-sender-installation
the DeliveryResponse type, undecodable and non-Outbox bytes, and Ingest Batches, which belong to accept-ingest-batch
HTTP routing, request limits, decompression, and Authorized Ingress, which belong to the Portal ingress shell
